children: Distributed Systems Management Limited said Hypercall will integrate Block Scholes institutional-grade oracle feeds to support pricing and risk management for on-chain options, with plans to expand from crypto into real-world assets.
Enhances pricing/risk data, a key input for liquidity and spreads in options markets.
Signals push beyond crypto; broader asset support can expand TAM and volumes.
Eases hedging for market makers, potentially improving depth and execution.
Better vol inputs can tighten quotes and reduce model risk for traders.

This is an early-stage infrastructure build to bolster Hypercall’s data and expand its product set. A catalyst would be measurable growth in listed assets, liquidity, and volumes after deployment of the new feeds.
